title: Build the overload intro motion graphic
summary: The exact ask to code the overload motion graphic was delivered: replies show the owner approved the scene direction, rejected the guitar, selected marimba, and the designer reported a final 18-second render committed as 8618491. The committed intro work is implemented and owner-reviewed at the component level; source commit is locally present. Later assembly has replaced this historical version: current Overload.tsx imports OverloadReveal and describes the reveal with Buddies robots and logo, and the launch task comment explicitly labels the old marimba/Introducing opening historical. Thus this thread ask is closed, but it is not evidence that this specific version shipped in the final published video. The two optional questions at the time (voice line and real logos) were not resolved in this thread; no evidence they block the original motion-graphic ask. The broader launch project remains in progress with pending recording/handoff/release and final approval work.
